issue.title: test_agents_bead_created_by_agent_narrow PNG test fails: narrow card shows BEAD fold section instead of the Beads lane
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_sase_context.py::test_agents_bead_created_by_agent_narrow_png_snapshot`
(visual lane) fails: the narrow agent card never renders the `Beads:` lane for created
bead touches and shows the fold-style BEAD section instead. No bead_created goldens are
committed, and sase-1ab.4 left one created golden (`bead_created` 120x40) untracked.

Proposed by sase-1ab.4 note #3 item 1, reproduced there on untouched code paths. The
sase-1ap.4 landing (bead creation reason visuals) touched the same area; check whether
the narrow layout should show the Beads lane, then fix the rendering or the test and
commit the missing goldens through `just fix-tui-screenshots` (via `/sase_monitor`).
Not caused by the turn rename.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The render deterministically lacks the Beads lane at the narrow size and no golden for it has ever been committed.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ab.4 note #3 item 1 as a clean-path visual failure with no committed goldens; no existing bead tracks it.
